references.text: Introduces the daughters of Zelophehad and notes that he had no sons, only daughters, which led to their claim for inheritance.
The daughters of Zelophehad present their case before Moses and ask to inherit their father's property since he had no sons.
Further development of the inheritance law for the daughters of Zelophehad, with additional provisions that they must marry within their own tribe.
Fulfillment of the promise to the daughters of Zelophehad when they received their inheritance in the land of Canaan.
General laws concerning inheritance and property in Israel, which form the background for principles of inheritance law.
Laws regarding the rights of the firstborn and inheritance, showing how inheritance rights were regulated in Israel.
